title: Counting the Days a Covered Appliance Stood Out of Use
content:
The days a covered appliance stood out of use under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan are counted
between two days, and which two depends on what stands recorded on the job for that item in the
records of Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair: whether a completion day stands recorded on
the job, and whether a diagnosis stands recorded on it.

| What the records show | The days are counted |
| --- | --- |
| a completion day stands recorded on the job for the covered item, and a diagnosis stands recorded on it | from the day the failure happened to the day the work was completed |
| a completion day stands recorded, and no diagnosis stands recorded on the job | from the day the failure was reported to the day the work was completed |
| every other claim | from the day the failure happened to the day the claim was decided |

### Points of judgement

Where no completion day stands recorded on the job at all, neither of the first two rows is reached,
whatever diagnoses stand on it, and the count runs to the day the claim was decided. Where a
completion day does stand recorded, the presence of a diagnosis alone decides whether the count opens
on the day the failure happened or on the day it was reported.

### A case on hypothetical dates

A failure happens on the 4th of a month and is reported on the 9th. The work on the item is completed on the
27th, and the claim is decided on the 30th.

| What the records show | Days counted |
| --- | --- |
| no completion day recorded | 26, from the 4th to the 30th |
| completion day recorded, no diagnosis on the job | 18, from the 9th to the 27th |
| completion day recorded, a diagnosis on the job | 23, from the 4th to the 27th |
